newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: La Tondena posts 40 percent rise in net.
newsitem.headline: La Tondena posts 40 percent rise in net.

text.p: La Tondena Distillers Inc, a unit of San Miguel Corp, said on Thursday net income rose 40 percent last year to 914 million pesos from 652 million pesos in 1995.
The 1996 figure included a one-time gain of 186 million pesos from a property sale.
Stripped of non-recurring items, net income was 728 million pesos last year, up 19 percent from 611 million pesos in 1995, the company said in a statement.
Considered the country's leader in the hard liquor industry, La Tondena generated net sales of 7.695 billion pesos, 31 percent higher than 5.888 billion pesos in 1995.

The company said its liquor sales volume slowed down with a growth of about 4.0 percent in 1996 due to price increases from higher raw material costs and deferments of orders by wholesalers adjusting to higher operating capital.
But La Tondena said vigorous growth came from its mineral water business and acquisition of the juice business of SMC Juice Inc, another unit of San Miguel.
It said further growth was expected in the mineral water business when its second bottling plant started commercial operations in the first quarter of this year.
